sections.title: TYPE SYSTEM — Protocol, Generic, TypeVar
sections.body:
```python name=type_system_oop.py
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  TYPE SYSTEM: Protocol + Generic + TypeVar
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
from typing import (TypeVar, Generic, Protocol,
                    List, Optional, Iterator,
                    runtime_checkable)
from abc import abstractmethod
from dataclasses import dataclass

# ─── TypeVar: Generic type placeholder ───
T  = TypeVar('T')           # any type
T_co = TypeVar('T_co', covariant=True)    # covariant
K  = TypeVar('K')           # key type
V  = TypeVar('V')           # value type
C  = TypeVar('C', bound='Comparable')    # must be Comparable

# ─── Protocol: Structural subtyping ("duck typing with types") ───
@runtime_checkable
class Comparable(Protocol):
    """
    Any class with __lt__ satisfies this Protocol.
    No need to explicitly inherit — structural matching!
    """
    @abstractmethod
    def __lt__(self, other) -> bool: ...

    @abstractmethod
    def __eq__(self, other) -> bool: ...

@runtime_checkable
class Sizeable(Protocol):
    """Any class with __len__ satisfies this"""
    def __len__(self) -> int: ...

@runtime_checkable
class Drawable(Protocol):
    """Any class with draw() satisfies this"""
    def draw(self) -> str: ...

# ─── Generic Class: typed container ───
class Stack(Generic[T]):
    """
    Type-safe Stack.
    Stack[int] only holds ints.
    Stack[str] only holds strings.
    Fully type-checked by mypy!
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self._items: List[T] = []

    def push(self, item: T) -> None:
        self._items.append(item)
        print(f"  📥 Pushed: {item!r}")

    def pop(self) -> T:
        if self.is_empty():
            raise IndexError("Stack is empty")
        item = self._items.pop()
        print(f"  📤 Popped: {item!r}")
        return item

    def peek(self) -> T:
        if self.is_empty():
            raise IndexError("Stack is empty")
        return self._items[-1]

    def is_empty(self) -> bool:
        return len(self._items) == 0

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._items)

    def __iter__(self) -> Iterator[T]:
        return iter(reversed(self._items))

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Stack[{type(self._items[0]).__name__ if self._items else '?'}]({self._items})"

class TypedCache(Generic[K, V]):
    """Type-safe key-value cache"""

    def __init__(self, max_size: int = 100):
        self._store   : dict    = {}
        self._max_size = max_size

    def set(self, key: K, value: V) -> None:
        if len(self._store) >= self._max_size:
            oldest = next(iter(self._store))
            del self._store[oldest]
        self._store[key] = value

    def get(self, key: K) -> Optional[V]:
        return self._store.get(key)

    def __contains__(self, key: K) -> bool:
        return key in self._store

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._store)

class SortedList(Generic[C]):
    """
    Generic sorted list — works with ANY Comparable type.
    TypeVar bound means C must implement __lt__ and __eq__.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self._items: List[C] = []

    def insert(self, item: C) -> None:
        # Binary insert to maintain sorted order
        lo, hi = 0, len(self._items)
        while lo < hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            if self._items[mid] < item:
                lo = mid + 1
            else:
                hi = mid
        self._items.insert(lo, item)

    def __iter__(self) -> Iterator[C]:
        return iter(self._items)

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._items)

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"SortedList({self._items})"

# ─── Protocol usage — no inheritance needed! ───
@dataclass
class Temperature:
    value: float
    unit : str = "C"

    def __lt__(self, other: 'Temperature') -> bool:
        return self.to_celsius() < other.to_celsius()

    def __eq__(self, other) -> bool:
        if not isinstance(other, Temperature): return False
        return abs(self.to_celsius() - other.to_celsius()) < 0.001

    def to_celsius(self) -> float:
        if self.unit == "F":
            return (self.value - 32) * 5/9
        return self.value

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"{self.value}°{self.unit}"

@dataclass
class Priority:
    level: int
    label: str

    def __lt__(self, other: 'Priority') -> bool:
        return self.level < other.level

    def __eq__(self, other) -> bool:
        if not isinstance(other, Priority): return False
        return self.level == other.level

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"P{self.level}({self.label})"

# ─── Testing ───
print("=" * 55)
print("  TYPE SYSTEM: Generic + Protocol")
print("=" * 55)

print("\n=== Generic Stack ===")
int_stack: Stack[int] = Stack()
int_stack.push(10)
int_stack.push(20)
int_stack.push(30)
print(f"Top: {int_stack.peek()}")
int_stack.pop()
print(f"Stack: {int_stack}")

str_stack: Stack[str] = Stack()
str_stack.push("hello")
str_stack.push("world")
print(f"\nStr stack: {str_stack}")

print("\n=== Typed Cache ===")
cache: TypedCache[str, dict] = TypedCache(max_size=3)
cache.set("user:1", {"name": "Alice", "age": 28})
cache.set("user:2", {"name": "Bob",   "age": 32})
print(f"user:1 in cache: {'user:1' in cache}")
print(f"user:1 data    : {cache.get('user:1')}")

print("\n=== Generic SortedList with Protocol ===")
# Works with Temperature — satisfies Comparable Protocol
temps: SortedList[Temperature] = SortedList()
temps.insert(Temperature(30, "C"))
temps.insert(Temperature(25, "C"))
temps.insert(Temperature(98.6, "F"))   # ~37°C
temps.insert(Temperature(0, "C"))
print("Temperatures (sorted):", list(temps))

# Works with Priority — also satisfies Comparable!
priorities: SortedList[Priority] = SortedList()
priorities.insert(Priority(3, "High"))
priorities.insert(Priority(1, "Critical"))
priorities.insert(Priority(5, "Low"))
priorities.insert(Priority(2, "Urgent"))
print("Priorities (sorted)  :", list(priorities))

print("\n=== Protocol isinstance check ===")
# runtime_checkable allows isinstance!
print(f"Temperature is Comparable: "
      f"{isinstance(Temperature(25), Comparable)}")
print(f"Stack is Sizeable        : "
      f"{isinstance(Stack(), Sizeable)}")
print(f"int is Comparable        : "
      f"{isinstance(42, Comparable)}")   # True — int has __lt__!
```
